## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour
- [ ] README or docs are updated if user-visible behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or credentialed URLs in code, logs or fixtures
